description:
Hushfeed v0.35.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Hide feed surveys no longer empties the profile's Favorites tab: TikTok gives that page the same view id as the feed survey card, and the overlay hider took every view with that id in the window. Feed furniture is now hidden only inside a feed cell. The Feature Gate Lab's switch rows are one screen-reader stop each and toggle from anywhere on the row, and an import that accepted something reports in a dialog with the first rejection selectable.

Validation: 1362 runtime tests passed locally, plus 203 in the patches module. The bundle carries 81 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. Both Android API checks passed. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
